# tgo

Package main builds the tgo command and connects it to the transpiler library.

Build the executable from the repository root:

```
make prepare
go build ./cmd/tgo
```

The command takes one directory argument and passes it to transpiler.Compile:

```
./tgo /path/to/module
```

See the [user guide](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/blob/main/docs/guide/transpiler.md>) to compile and run a project. Use the [transpiler package](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/blob/main/pkg/transpiler/readme.md>) to call the compiler from a Go program.
